prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 89.9%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 26.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Stage Waiting Progress Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a dynamic stage layout with real-time render progress indicators and visual pet previews. (why: The home waiting stage has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to high drop-off before reaching the desktop.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Pet Desktop Sandbox Screen: Add a dedicated desktop controls sandbox screen after home intro guiding users through dragging, hiding, and right-clicking their pet. (why: Support receives multiple emails regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post Adoption Certificate Sign In Shift: Move sign-in to take place immediately after completing the adoption certificate step to tie account registration directly to pet ownership. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after sign-in, and signing in before picking a pet causes premature drop-off.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Sync Warning Copy: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to assure returning users that their existing pets will be automatically synced. (why: 8 emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Account Protection Hint: Add an explicit sync guarantee hint on the adoption certificate screen to reduce anxiety about losing pet creation details. (why: Adoption drop-off is 30.1% (69.9% conversion) with a long mean duration of 1017 seconds.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Spawn Ready Alert: Enable desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen so users can be notified when their pet finishes loading. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets not showing or apps stalling while users waited, with long waiting mean times.)
6: [finish, layout] Home Intro Split Screen Controls Layout: Redesign the home intro layout into a split screen featuring video guidance on controlling desktop pet features. (why: Users report confusion around controlling, hiding, and talking to their pet after completing onboarding.)
7: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Generation Stage Timer: Display an active timer and rotating tip carousel on the waiting screen to keep users informed during rendering. (why: The waiting step mean time is 2336 seconds and users often assume the application has stalled.)
